comment: * Interface to watch for changes to the back stack.

methods.name: void onBackStackChanged()
methods.comment:
* Called whenever the contents of the back stack change, after the * fragment manager has moved all of the fragments to their final state. * *

* This is the final callback that will be delivered to the listener in all cases except * for when the predictive back gesture is cancelled. It will be called after * {@link #onBackStackChangeCommitted(Fragment, boolean)}.

methods.name: void onBackStackChangeStarted(@NonNull Fragment fragment, boolean pop)
methods.comment:
* Called whenever the contents of the back stack are starting to be changed, before * any fragment actually changes its lifecycle state. If this is caused by a forward * transaction and the given fragment is incoming, it will return false from * {@link Fragment#isRemoving()}. If this is caused by a pop operation and the given * fragment is being popped, it will return true from * {@link Fragment#isRemoving()}. * *

* This is the first callback that will be delivered to the listener. If the transaction * is caused by a predictive back gesture, it will be followed by an * {@link #onBackStackChangeProgressed(BackEventCompat)} callback otherwise, the next * callback will be {@link #onBackStackChangeCommitted(Fragment, boolean)}. * * @param fragment one of the fragments that is affected by the starting back stack change * @param pop true, if this callback was triggered by a pop operation, false otherwise

methods.name: void onBackStackChangeProgressed(@NonNull BackEventCompat backEventCompat)
methods.comment:
* Called whenever a predictive back gesture is changing the back stack. This will continue * to be called with an updated {@link BackEventCompat} object until the gesture is either * cancelled or completed. * *

* This is called immediately after {@link #onBackStackChangeStarted(Fragment, boolean)} * during a predictive back gesture. If the gesture is completed, this will be followed by * {@link #onBackStackChangeCommitted(Fragment, boolean)} and if it is cancelled, it will be * followed by {@link #onBackStackChangeCancelled()}. * * @param backEventCompat provides the current progress of the active predictive back * gesture

methods.name: void onBackStackChangeCommitted(@NonNull Fragment fragment, boolean pop)
methods.comment:
* Called whenever the contents of a back stack change is committed. If this is caused by * a forward transaction and the given fragment is incoming, it will return * false from {@link Fragment#isRemoving()}. If this is caused by a pop * operation and the given fragment is being popped, it will return true from * {@link Fragment#isRemoving()}. * *

* This is called immediately after {@link #onBackStackChangeStarted(Fragment, boolean)} * for a forward transaction or for a non-predictive back pop. If this is caused by a * predictive back gesture, it will be called after * {@link #onBackStackChangeProgressed(BackEventCompat)} before the fragment moves to the * final state. * * @param fragment one of the fragments that is affected by the committed back stack change * @param pop true, if this callback was triggered by a pop operation, false otherwise

methods.name: void onBackStackChangeCancelled()
methods.comment:
* Called whenever a predictive back gesture is cancelled. * *

* This is called immediately after {@link #onBackStackChangeProgressed(BackEventCompat)} * once a predictive back gesture has been cancelled and will place the FragmentManager back * into the state before the predictive back gesture was started.

methodNames: void onBackStackChangeStarted(@NonNull Fragment fragment, boolean pop)
void onBackStackChangeCommitted(@NonNull Fragment fragment, boolean pop)
